KARNATAKA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
NOTIFICATION NO. PSC 1 RTB-2/2026
DATED: 20.01.2026
RECRUITMENT FOR GAZETTED PROBATIONERS (GROUP A & B) POSTS - 2026

The Karnataka Public Service Commission invites online applications from eligible candidates for Gazetted Probationers (Group A and Group B) posts.
Total Vacancies: 384 posts (RPC: 284, HK: 100).
Application submission commences on 25.01.2026 and last date to apply is 28.02.2026.
Preliminary Examination Date: 05.07.2026.
Main Examination will be held tentatively in November 2026 followed by Personality Test.
